definitions.explanation: A product label and ingredient description meaning 'containing no added salt.' Common on butter, nuts, crackers, and processed foods marketed to people on low-sodium diets.

examples.japanese: {無塩|むえん}⟦バター→バター：04671_bataa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{無塩|むえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勧|すす}められた→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: The doctor recommended a salt-free diet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{減塩|げんえん}→減塩：21843_genen⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{無塩|むえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{見|み}つからない→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for salt-free products, not just reduced-salt ones, but they're hard to find.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) + {塩|えん} (salt; えん in compounds, しお on its own). Used as a noun modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or directly attached as a prefix-style label.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無塩|むえん}⟦バター→バター：04671_bataa⟧: unsalted butter
- {無塩|むえん}{食|しょく}: salt-free meal/diet
- {無塩|むえん}⟦ナッツ→ナッツ：11253_nattsu⟧: unsalted nuts
- {無塩|むえん}⟦{調理|ちょうり}→調理：07156_chouri⟧: salt-free cooking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{減塩|げんえん}→減塩：21843_genen⟧: reduced-salt — salt is present but in smaller amounts
- ⟦{有塩|ゆうえん}→有塩：28598_yuuen⟧: salted — the direct opposite
- {低塩|ていえん}: low-salt — similar to ⟦{減塩|げんえん}→減塩：21843_genen⟧
